 MEMPHIS, Tenn. - Shelby County utility assistance applications open Monday.
 Residents who need help paying their utility bills can begin applying for assistance starting Monday, November 16, 2026, when the LIHEAP application portal opens.
 The Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program, known as LIHEAP, helps qualifying households cover the cost of home energy bills.
 Community Services Agency, or CSA, will be accepting applications through an online portal only. No in-person applications will be taken for this program.
 The online application window is available on Mondays and Wednesdays from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
 Residents interested in applying should be ready to submit their application during those designated hours on the program's portal beginning the week of November 16. Click here for more information.
